subtitles.text: The story begins in a small kingdom.
Here our hero Will, lives.
His neighbor is named Eldran, and he has taken care of him since he was little.
There's a letter on the table... What might it contain?
So... the star has finally awakened.
The first step is complete...
Will arrives with the fruit box.
Suddenly he senses something.
A fireball is heading towards them.
Will closes his eyes and unknowingly unleashes powerful magic.
And a fireball shoots from his hands, completely deflecting the projectile.
Will is confused about what just happened when suddenly...
The ground trembles and a dark figure emerges amid smoke and fire: a demon.
Eldran shouts: 'Will! Use your magic, press <sprite name="interactable_x"> and defeat the demon!'
[EN] Las arañas creían haber acorralado a una presa indefensa. No sabían que acababan de encerrarse con Estela.
[EN] Con una sonrisa de desafío, Estela liberó su verdadero poder.
[EN] Con un guiño pícaro y una sonrisa de satisfacción, Estela contempló su obra. No quedó ni una sola araña en pie.
Estela: Hmph. Just as I predicted. The explosion trajectory was perfect.
Estela: I had it all calculated.
Will: Calculated? You tripped before shooting! Just admit it...
Will: It was a miracle we didn't end up as mush.
Liam (from the shadows): That sorceress is an unforeseen problem in my equation.
Liam: The Golem has failed. If I want the boy to reach the end, I'll have to guide him myself.
